entry_contract: Continue from 05 Bloodmyst Isle, or select this chapter on a partially completed character. Begin in The Exodar with Dugiru. Leave at least two quest-log slots open.

steps.instruction: Travel from Bloodmyst Isle to The Exodar. Use a known flight path when it saves time; otherwise follow roads and zone connections. Continue to [G63.51,67.74 The Exodar]. [O]
Before you begin: travel to The Exodar and meet the first quest giver at [G63.51,67.74 The Exodar]. Leave at least two quest-log slots open. [O]
